findings.title: anchor/last_end pairing flow-implied
findings.detail: Window pairs last_summary anchor with rate.last_end; single-segment runner flow keeps them consistent, but a future mid-run reanchor+close could mix segments while passing type/span checks.
findings.reproduce: Hypothetical: call rate.reanchor(..., recovery=True) mid-run then fail before close_segment; last_summary holds the old segment anchor while last_end belongs to the new segment.

findings.title: native handle leak on stop failure by design
findings.detail: Failed stop leaves the handle live until process exit; no destructor stop, documented deliberately; recorded via owns_handle_after.

findings.title: except BaseException traps KeyboardInterrupt inside finalize
findings.detail: Interrupt during capture.stop() becomes a failed marker; cleanup still completes; in-flight exceptions unaffected. Deliberate fail-closed trade-off.
